title: Text: DET Dave Littlefield ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Writing a column on Perez’s injury. Was he going to start the season in AA? Barring no late injury

So how would I frame this. You guys like going 20-30% innings increase. Perez threw 19 this season, injury plagued. Would it be fair to say that 75-80 next year would be about his limit? Or that 100 would be unlikely?
Too early to say. Lot of factors to consider
